name: Bolt
primary:
Lightning leaps from your hand into the target and jumps to those nearby.
Lightning shoots from your hand into the creature you aim at (or the first one in your line of sight). Effects:
• Damage 1.5 ❤ lightning (lightning ×2 on wet)
• Charge 70: weakness, stuns for 1 s at 65 charge (×2 on wet)
• Then the lightning jumps onward: up to 3 targets in a row, jumps up to 4 blocks, 1 ❤ and 40 charge each (×2 damage and longer jumps on wet, ×1.5 range in puddles)
